svg.aria-label: The capability stack of a top-tier electronics factory an ESL buyer should audit: SMT and inspection, functional and RF test, reliability lab, quality system and certifications
svg.text: WHAT TO AUDIT — A TOP-TIER FACTORY CAPABILITY STACK

g.text: 10-zone reflow with profiled curve · 100% SPI 3D paste (height/area/volume, closed-loop SPC) · MES anti-mixing traceability · AOI to IPC-A-610 · X-ray on hidden joints
Per-unit FCT (boot current, module voltages, RSSI, MAC/HW read) · shield-box Wi-Fi/BLE Tx power · VNA for antenna match · spectrum analyser for noise · power monitor for standby
Temp-humidity (−60 to 150°C) · salt spray (NSS/CASS per JIS/ASTM/GB) · drop & vibration (GB/UL/IEC) · ESD/surge · alcohol-rubber abrasion for printed marks · transport simulation
In-house cell / pack line · pack ATE + aging · protection-board test · IP-rated airtight test · UN 38.3 documentation
ISO 9001 · ISO 14001 · IATF 16949 discipline · IQC/PQC/NPI/Lab-QC + QA/SQE/DQE · third-party-accredited in-house lab · UL/ETL/CSA/PSE/KC · retailer supplier audits

svg.text: Audit top-down: a factory strong at layer 5 but hollow at layers 1–3 is a paperwork shop. Real control shows at every layer.
